description: This file defines the 'ArithmeticUtils' class, providing static methods for advanced arithmetic operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication with overflow checking, computation of factorials, binomial coefficients, greatest common divisors, least common multiples, powers, and Stirling numbers. It is part of the Apache Commons Math library and offers utility functions to perform precise and overflow-safe arithmetic calculations.

classes.name: ArithmeticUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for performing precise arithmetic operations with overflow checks, calculating combinatorial numbers, factorials, gcd, lcm, powers, and Stirling numbers.

methods.name: addAndCheck
methods.description: Adds two integers with overflow check, throws MathArithmeticException if overflow occurs.

methods.name: addAndCheck
methods.description: Adds two longs with overflow check, throws MathArithmeticException if overflow occurs.

methods.name: binomialCoefficient
methods.description: Computes the exact binomial coefficient (n choose k), deprecated in favor of CombinatoricsUtils.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientDouble
methods.description: Computes the binomial coefficient as a double, deprecated in favor of CombinatoricsUtils.

methods.name: binomialCoefficientLog
methods.description: Computes the log of the binomial coefficient, deprecated in favor of CombinatoricsUtils.

methods.name: factorial
methods.description: Computes factorial of n, deprecated in favor of CombinatoricsUtils.

methods.name: factorialDouble
methods.description: Computes factorial of n as a double, deprecated in favor of CombinatoricsUtils.

methods.name: factorialLog
methods.description: Computes the logarithm of factorial n, deprecated in favor of CombinatoricsUtils.

methods.name: gcd
methods.description: Calculates the greatest common divisor of two integers, supporting overflow checks and special cases.

methods.name: gcd
methods.description: Calculates the greatest common divisor of two longs, supporting overflow checks and special cases.

methods.name: lcm
methods.description: Computes the least common multiple of two integers, with overflow handling.

methods.name: lcm
methods.description: Computes the least common multiple of two longs, with overflow handling.

methods.name: mulAndCheck
methods.description: Multiplies two integers with overflow detection, throws exception if overflow occurs.

methods.name: mulAndCheck
methods.description: Multiplies two longs with overflow detection, throws exception if overflow occurs.

methods.name: subAndCheck
methods.description: Subtracts two integers with overflow check.

methods.name: subAndCheck
methods.description: Subtracts two longs with overflow check.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises an integer to a non-negative integer power, with overflow detection.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises an long to a non-negative integer power, with overflow detection.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises an integer to a long power, deprecated in favor of the method with int exponent.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a long to an int power, with overflow detection.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a long to a long power, with overflow detection.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a BigInteger to an int power.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a BigInteger to a long power.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Raises a BigInteger to a BigInteger power.

methods.name: stirlingS2
methods.description: Computes the Stirling number of the second kind, deprecated in favor of CombinatoricsUtils.

methods.name: isPowerOfTwo
methods.description: Checks if a long number is a power of two.
